name: Spaghetti with Creamy Basil-Spinach Sauce, Tomatoes, Walnuts & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve 1½ cups of pasta cooking water before draining.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach
1 ½ small pkgs fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop walnuts, place in a small bowl, and set aside.
Place peas in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Transfer to a large bowl.
Peel garlic and add to the bowl with the peas.
Pick basil leaves off the stems and add to the bowl.

Add spinach, half of the feta (reserving remaining feta for garnish), cream cheese, oil, salt, and 1½ cups reserved pasta water to the bowl. Working in batches if necessary, transfer the spinach mixture to a blender and purée sauce until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese
¾ (227 g) block cream cheese
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Return drained pasta to the pot. Add sauce and tomatoes; stir to combine.
Return pot to medium-low heat and cook, stirring often, until sauce coats the pasta and tomatoes are warmed through, 3-4 minutes.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls; top with walnuts, remaining feta, and crushed red pepper. Enjoy!
